adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `TopicEmbed.import` to derive the category from `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` (`eh.try(:category_id)`) instead of the global `SiteSetting.embed_category` (which is removed). From the code shown, if there is no matching `EmbeddableHost` row, `eh` is `nil` and `category:` is passed as `nil` to `PostCreator`, which can change where the topic ends up (likely default/uncategorized). While other entrypoints in this diff now gate on `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` (e.g. `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`, `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`), the diff does not prove all callers of `TopicEmbed.import` are gated, so this is a real edge-case behavior change/risk but not conclusively a defect from the diff alone.
